build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a ball on a table with a container goal
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball on the scene with randomized radius and position using C.add
add_box_table: add a box as a table surface using vt.add_box with randomized width and height
add_container_goal: add a container goal using vt.add_container with randomized vertex positions and dimensions
update_task_relationship: update the task goal to require the ball touching the container using C.update_task
